name: Calico Cow Fabric & Gift Shop
old_description: Our wonderful ladies that will help you choose the perfect fabric for any occasion!
about:
Calico Cow Fabric & Gift Shop operates in Roswell, New Mexico, at 200 East College Boulevard. The business has been serving the local quilting and sewing community since at least 2007, as indicated by its website copyright. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop stocks a wide range of cotton and specialty fabrics, pre-cut bundles, embroidery supplies, leather goods, and finished accessories from brands such as Moda, Michael Miller, and Susybee. In addition to retail sales, it provides sewing machine maintenance and repair services, and offers quilting and sewing classes through its classroom space.

Customers include hobbyist quilters, garment sewists, crafters, and gift shoppers from across southeastern New Mexico. The store’s product mix targets both traditional and modern quilting markets, with themed collections for animals, seasonal prints, and designer lines.

The company emphasizes personalized assistance, noting that its staff helps customers select the perfect fabric for any project. This service-oriented approach, combined with on-site machine repair, distinguishes it from online-only fabric retailers.
